name: cli-kanban
description: A kanban board of Markdown files in your repository: a skill that tells the agent how to work with tickets, and an MCP server to move them.

interface.shortDescription: Tickets as Markdown files in kanban/, moved by the agent
interface.longDescription: A kanban board that lives in your repository: one folder per state, one Markdown file per ticket. The agent picks up a ticket, moves it through todo, doing, testing and done, ticks its acceptance criteria and records decisions in it. Works next to Jira or GitHub issues, or on its own.
defaultPrompt: What is on the kanban board?
Plan this feature into tickets on the board.
Pick the next ticket from todo and work on it.
